english.title: Drive / cause / permit to be driven vehicle that fails to comply with requirements at Bristol Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[drove a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[caused a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), to be driven,]_
(C)_[permitted a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), to be driven,]_

which failed to comply with any

(D)_[braking,]_
(E)_[steering,]_
(F)_[lighting,]_
(G)_[tyre,]_
(H)_[electrical,]_
(I)_[**(..SPECIFY COMBINATION OF THE ABOVE..),]_requirements which would have applied to that type of vehicle if it were operated on a road to which the Road Traffic Enactments apply, on a part of Bristol Airport to which the Road Traffic Enactments did not apply, namely **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 6.7 and 3.3 of the Bristol Airport Byelaws 2012 and sections 63 and 64 of the Airports Act 1986.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
drive / cause / permit to be driven
vehicle which fails to comply with
braking / steering / lighting / tyre / electrical requirements / combination of above
that apply when used where Road Traffic Enactments apply
on part of Bristol Airport
where Road Traffic Enactments do not apply

english.notes: This Byelaw applies on any part of the Airport to which the road traffic enactments do not apply.
